text: MEDVET — MODELO Y ESQUEMA DE BASE DE DATOS

USERS (Usuarios)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
📧 email : VARCHAR (UQ)
🔒 password : VARCHAR (Hash)
👤 name : VARCHAR
📞 phone : VARCHAR
🎭 role : ENUM ('admin', 'vet'...)
⚡ active : BOOLEAN (true)
⏱️ created_at : TIMESTAMP
⏱️ updated_at : TIMESTAMP

PROFESSIONALS (Especialistas)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
🔗 user_id : UUID (FK->users.id, UQ)
🩺 specialty : VARCHAR
⚡ active : BOOLEAN (true)
⏱️ created_at : TIMESTAMP

SCHEDULES (Horarios / Turnos)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
🔗 professional_id : UUID (FK->prof.)
📅 day_of_week : INT (0-6)
⏰ start_time : TIME
⏰ end_time : TIME
⚡ active : BOOLEAN (true)

PETS (Mascotas / Pacientes)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
🔗 user_id : UUID (FK->users.id)
🐾 name : VARCHAR
🐕 species : VARCHAR
🧬 breed : VARCHAR
🎂 age : INT
⚖️ weight : DECIMAL(5,2)
🖼️ photo : VARCHAR
⏱️ created_at : TIMESTAMP

SERVICES (Catálogo Clínico)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
📋 name : VARCHAR
📝 description : TEXT
⏳ duration : INT (Minutos)
💵 price : DECIMAL(10,2) (USD)
🏷️ category : ENUM ('consulta'...)
⚡ active : BOOLEAN (true)
⏱️ created_at : TIMESTAMP

APPOINTMENTS (Citas Médicas)
-------------------------
🔑 id : UUID (PK)
🔗 user_id : UUID (FK->users.id)
🔗 pet_id : UUID (FK->pets.id)
🔗 professional_id : UUID (FK->prof.)
🔗 service_id : UUID (FK->services.id)
📅 date : DATE
⏰ start_time : TIME
⏰ end_time : TIME
📊 status : ENUM ('pending', 'confirmed'...)
📋 notes : TEXT
⏱️ created_at : TIMESTAMP
⏱️ updated_at : TIMESTAMP
